solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Military force calling for withdrawal

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
a calling is a vocation, one's chosen career

explanation.surface: Troops are summoned to pull back from the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Revoking something is withdrawing it, so the act of cancellation is a withdrawal.

clue.text: Pet that's all the fashion

definitions.meaning: a pet is a sulky fit of temper
something all the fashion is the current craze

explanation.definitionFit: Both a fit of temper and a passing craze go by this word: 'the latest rage'.

clue.text: Only a small number show support

parts.note: five is only a small number, V in Roman numerals
to show is to indicate

explanation.surface: Few people turn up to back a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: To vindicate a claim is to justify or uphold it, giving it support.

clue.text: Smart girl that is after a share of the proceeds

indicators.note: the abbreviation for 'that is' comes after the share in the answer

parts.note: one's cut is a share of the takings
i.e. is the Latin abbreviation id est, that is

explanation.surface: A clever young woman wants her share of the profits.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutie is an attractive, smart-looking girl; 'smart' here means stylish.

clue.text: Moving near the foreign capital

indicators.note: moving the letters about shuffles the words near the

explanation.surface: We are travelling close to an overseas city.
explanation.walkthrough: TEHERAN is an older spelling of Tehran, capital of Iran.
explanation.definitionFit: Tehran, also spelt this way, is the capital city of Iran, a foreign country to the British solver.

clue.text: Such food is grown, naturally

parts.note: food grown naturally, without artificial chemicals, is described by this word; 'naturally' also reads as 'of course'

explanation.definitionFit: Organic produce is farmed without synthetic fertilisers or pesticides, by natural methods.

clue.text: I make an offer in place of a previous quotation

definitions.text: in place of a previous quotation

parts.note: to bid is to make an offer, at auction for example

explanation.surface: Someone bids at a sale instead of quoting an earlier price.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibid., Latin ibidem 'in the same place', is used in references to repeat the previous citation.

clue.text: Cake in hamper?

definitions.meaning: a cake of soap or ice is a solid ...
to hamper is to obstruct or ...

explanation.definitionFit: A solid lump, as in a cake of soap, and an act of obstructing both share this word.

clue.text: Share out is tried but in an alternative way

indicators.note: arranged in an alternative way signals the letters of is tried but are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone has a go at sharing but does it differently.
explanation.definitionFit: To share out is to deal or hand round portions, a straight synonym.

clue.text: It really is a breathtaking experience

definitions.text: It really is a breathtaking experience

parts.words: It really is a breathtaking experience
parts.note: breathtaking taken literally: something that stops you breathing, i.e. suffocation

explanation.definitionFit: Asphyxia is a lack of oxygen from being unable to breathe, literally taking the breath away.

clue.text: DNA unit takes time to find cat-like creature

parts.note: a gene is a unit of heredity made of DNA

explanation.surface: A genetic unit needs a while to identify a feline animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A genet is a small civet-like carnivore resembling a slender cat.

clue.text: The best parts of holidays in mountains?

definitions.text: The best parts of holidays in mountains?

parts.words: The best parts of holidays in mountains?
parts.note: the best moments of anything are its highlights; on a mountain holiday the lofty places are literally elevated

explanation.definitionFit: The highlights of an event are its peak moments, and mountain summits are literally lofty places.

clue.text: Reforged inferior poker, perhaps?

indicators.note: metal reforged is remade in a new shape, so the letters of inferior are recast

explanation.surface: A badly made fireside tool has been hammered out again.
explanation.definitionFit: A poker is one example of the metal tools kept by a hearth, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: One may take longer when one travels without a hitch

definitions.text: One may take longer when one travels without a hitch

parts.words: One may take longer when one travels without a hitch
parts.note: 'without a hitch' sounds like 'smoothly' but means without hitching a lift, so the walker is slower

explanation.definitionFit: A rambler on foot, not thumbing lifts, takes longer to reach a destination.

clue.text: Premier League team after victory in Sussex town

indicators.note: the football club comes after the victory in the answer

parts.note: a victory is a win
Chelsea is a London football club in England's Premier League

explanation.surface: A top football club travels to a south-coast town after a victory.
explanation.walkthrough: Sussex is a county on England's south coast; Winchelsea is a small town there.
explanation.definitionFit: Winchelsea is a historic small town in East Sussex, one of the Cinque Ports' 'ancient towns'.

clue.text: I managed to name one from 4 Down

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it, so managed is ran
Ian is a man's name

explanation.surface: Someone manages to name a person from a foreign city.
explanation.walkthrough: 4 Down is the capital of Iran, so one from there is a native of Iran.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Tehran is a native of Iran, so a national of that country.

clue.text: I mention changes straight away

indicators.note: 'changes' as a verb tells us the letters of I mention are altered in order

explanation.surface: Someone says they will make alterations immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in very little time means immediately, an idiom for straight away.

clue.text: Director of river boats to keep locks in order? That's dandy!

parts.note: the cox steers and directs a rowing boat on the river
locks of hair are kept tidy with a comb

explanation.surface: A rowing steerer who keeps his hair neat must be quite the fop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Locks' pulls towards canal locks on a river, but here it means hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A coxcomb is a vain, showy man, an old word for a fop or dandy.

clue.text: Failure to notice surveillance

definitions.meaning: supervision or watchful charge over something

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an inadvertent omission and supervisory watch, opposite senses of looking over.

clue.text: Is inclined to enter Church to absolve sins?

indicators.note: the leaning word goes in, entering the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
one who is inclined leans

explanation.surface: Someone tends to come to church to have their sins forgiven.
explanation.definitionFit: To purify someone morally, freeing them of guilt, is to wash them clean of sin.

clue.text: Typical measure by couple to show affection

parts.note: an em is a printer's measure of type width, 'typical' meaning of type
a brace is a pair or couple, of birds for example

explanation.surface: A loving pair demonstrate their typical fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: To hug or hold someone close is a physical demonstration of fondness.

clue.text: Superlatively daring pieces of underwear

parts.note: a bra is an undergarment
a vest is a British undershirt

explanation.surface: The most daring of underclothes.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a vest is an undershirt, not a waistcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative form of the adjective for daring or courageous.

clue.text: Be born healthy, get an advantage

parts.note: taken as written
née or né, French for born, used for maiden names, gives NE
a healthy person is fit

explanation.surface: Being born in good health puts you ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To profit or gain from something is to be helped by it, an advantage gained.

clue.text: Pass one bill in ten after amendment

indicators.note: the account abbreviation goes in the rearranged ten
the word ten after amendment has its letters rearranged

parts.note: a bill or account is abbreviated a/c, AC

explanation.surface: Parliament passes a single bill out of ten once it has been amended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pass' looks like a verb about getting through, but here it means passing a law; 'one bill' is a single account, not a banknote.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass a law is to make it statute, to enact it.

clue.text: Be of one mind about being in time

indicators.note: the word for about is set inside the period of time

parts.note: an age is a period of time
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Two people agree about being punctual.
explanation.definitionFit: To concur is to share an opinion with someone, holding the same view.

clue.text: Plucky player gets support following veto

indicators.note: the supporting beam follows the veto in the answer

parts.note: a veto bans something
a joist is a supporting beam

explanation.surface: A brave performer gets backing after a prohibition.
explanation.definitionFit: A banjo player plucks the strings, so 'plucky' is a pun for a plucking musician.

clue.text: Initially agreed, a mixed-up type animal

parts.note: OK, a pair of initials, means agreed
pie or pi is printer's type jumbled together

explanation.surface: At first everyone agreed it was a muddled sort of creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi is an African mammal related to the giraffe.

clue.text: Kink in nautical knot

definitions.meaning: a kink is a twist or curve
a sailor's knot joining two ropes

explanation.definitionFit: A curve in a line and a sailor's rope-joining knot share this name.

clue.text: He passes out at the back of the pack

definitions.text: He passes out at the back of the pack

parts.words: He passes out at the back of the pack
parts.note: in rugby the player behind the scrum passes the ball out; 'passes out' suggests fainting

explanation.definitionFit: In rugby union the scrum-half feeds the scrum and passes the ball out to the backs.

clue.text: Where two sides come together to some degree

definitions.text: Where two sides come together to some degree

parts.words: Where two sides come together to some degree
parts.note: two lines meeting form a corner, measured in degrees

explanation.definitionFit: Geometry measures the corner between two meeting lines in degrees.

clue.text: A parson taken aback enough to swear

indicators.note: taken aback means the parson's title is read backwards

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a parson's title

explanation.surface: A clergyman is startled enough to curse.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to declare firmly, as when one solemnly asserts something.

clue.text: Limited form of credit provided after period of unemployment

indicators.note: the rearranged credit is put after the rest

parts.note: a rest is a period without work

indicators.note: a form of the word credit means its letters reshaped

explanation.surface: A restricted kind of credit is available once you have been out of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Restricted and limited both mean kept within bounds, a straight synonym.
